fusions.name: Wishbone Split
fusions.desc: A falling kick that deals 13 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every tenth of your health already gone, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Headsman's Turn
fusions.desc: Brings a wing down on a target at or below 25% health for 22 damage, using up your afflictions on it and adding their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Headless Sprint
fusions.desc: Your movement speed rises by 40% for 6 seconds, and you gain 10% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Spared the Block
fusions.desc: When your health falls below half, your physical damage rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
